verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-filing and compliance service, not a platform where users build their own automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a category error for this product. The 'auto-filing of your annual reports' it offers is a vendor-run filing service, not a user-authored automation, and nothing in the evidence shows user-configurable workflows that could be versioned or rolled back.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
